description: This source file defines the RandomErrorInjector class implementing ITransactionFaultInjector interface, used for injecting random faults in transaction processing within Orleans framework. It includes nested exception classes for fault simulation.

classes.name: RandomErrorInjector
classes.description: Injects random faults during transaction storage operations, based on specified probabilities.

classes.name: RandomlyInjectedStorageException
classes.description: Exception thrown to simulate storage faults

classes.name: RandomlyInjectedInconsistentStateException
classes.description: Exception thrown to simulate inconsistent state faults

methods.name: RandomErrorInjector
methods.description: Constructor initializing fault probabilities based on overall injection probability.

methods.name: BeforeStore
methods.description: Method to possibly inject a storage or state inconsistency fault before storing.

methods.name: AfterStore
methods.description: Method to possibly inject a storage fault after storing.

methods.description: Custom exception class for storage faults.
